notes: Expands Documents so Manager/Admin can deliberately export any controlled files, not only approved/current ones. Adds Documents > Downloads with type and scope selectors for approved/current, all active latest regardless of approval, pending/unapproved, archived latest, or every stored version/full history; supports all document types including RA, COSHH RA, SSW, SDS/MSDS, Toolbox Talks, Policies, Procedures and Other. Each selection can be downloaded as a ZIP of separate PDFs plus INDEX.csv, or as an index PDF/CSV. Adds quick full-library active, pending and full-history exports. All Links PDF/CSV now includes both document-to-document links and Training/Toolbox Talk-to-document links. Documents > Linking is now a general all-document linking centre with search/type filtering and access to the Chemical/COSHH completeness check. Includes all v2.10.53 fixes and earlier features. No database migration required.
